title: HPSM-POC focus ring: the third round failed its check, and the band under the menu is 133 px at the page's end, not 72. One more small round, land as is, or hold?
bluf: Tap a for one more small round. First a correction: I told you the band under the menu is the top bar's 72 px and never more. The check measured 133 px once the page is scrolled to its end. You accepted the band on my wrong number. The round fixed most of it: the outline is clear on all four edges in 1,752 of 1,752 cells, no word changed, and the page no longer jumps when you start at the top. It still failed on two things. The page jumps when you have scrolled down and Tab back up the menu: 266 presses. Today's site does that too. And the menu now nudges 1 px where it does not need to: 25 presses, which today's site does not do. Nothing has landed.

options.label: One more small round (round 4)

options.label: Hold it
options.detail: Nothing lands; today's site keeps the ring that cuts the left edge and the page jumps as now. Your menu changes from this morning wait, since they build on this branch's files.
